Length-p factor zero counts equal (p+H(t+p)−H(t))/2. Three pairwise unequal counts can only occur for even p=2s at even starting time, and then exactly if differences x_(j+s)−x_j,x_(j+2s)−x_(j+s),x_(j+3s)−x_(j+2s) are a permutation of −1,0,+1. Avoidance is equivalent to equal outer bits forcing four identical bits along all 4-term arithmetic progressions. Run-crossing argument forces code constant zero, fully alternating, or three runs 0^a1^b0^c with b≥3,(a,c)∈{(1,1),(1,2),(2,1)}; corresponding n congruences yield five disjoint word templates and T_n formula.
